en: Black-and-white postcard photograph of a lakeside scene. In the foreground there is an unpaved road with a simple wooden guardrail and some stone posts, bordered by trees and shrubs. Beyond the road lies a calm lake with sunlight reflecting on the water, and forested low hills on the opposite shore under a cloudy sky. Printed captions appear at the bottom, one at the left describing the view and a publisher's imprint at the right.
